from pathlib import Path
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: edge=True
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            if not edge:
                # fill enclosed regions, selecting 7 for odd-width/height interiors and 2 for even
                color=7 if len(comp)**0.5 % 2 else 2
                for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
